2609.26368.title: HySparse2: Hybrid Sparse Attention with Two-Level KV Sharing
2609.26368.paper_summary: Long-horizon and multi-turn agents typically generate short actions and process long observations from tools and environments. This growing context demands efficient prefill, compact KV-cache storage, and accurate long-context retrieval. To meet these demands, we introduce HySparse2, a hybrid sparse attention architecture with two-level KV sharing. At the outer level, KV Bridging adopts a YOCO-style self-decoder and cross-decoder structure, but bridges only full-attention layers. The self-decoder uses hybrid sliding-window attention (SWA), while the cross-decoder uses hybrid sparse attention. The KV caches for full-attention layers in the cross-decoder are generated from the hidden states of full-attention layers in the self-decoder. At the inner level, HySparse2 retains HySparse's core KV Reuse design with two refinements. First, it replaces block-level sparsity with token-level sparsity for finer long-context retrieval. Second, it removes the separate SWA branch from sparse layers and instead forces a sliding window of recent tokens into the sparse selection. This two-level KV sharing allows all cross-decoder KV caches to be constructed from self-decoder hidden states. Prefill can therefore exit after the self-decoder, skipping all cross-decoder layers. On an 80B-A3B MoE model, HySparse2 outperforms HySparse and Hybrid SWA on long-context retrieval and multi-turn agentic tasks, while substantially reducing prefill computation and KV-cache storage.
2609.26368.paper_summary_zh: 長期視野和多回合代理通常生成短暫的行動並處理來自工具和環境的長觀察。這種不斷增長的上下文需求高效的預填充、緊湊的KV快取存儲和準確的長上下文檢索。為了滿足這些需求，我們引入了HySparse2，一種具有兩級KV共享的混合稀疏注意力架構。在外層，KV Bridging採用了YOCO風格的自解碼器和交叉解碼器結構，但僅連接全注意力層。自解碼器使用混合滑動窗口注意力（SWA），而交叉解碼器則使用混合稀疏注意力。交叉解碼器中全注意力層的KV快取是從自解碼器中全注意力層的隱藏狀態生成的。在內層，HySparse2保留了HySparse的核心KV重用設計，並進行了兩項改進。首先，它將區塊級稀疏性替換為標記級稀疏性，以便於更精細的長上下文檢索。其次，它從稀疏層中移除了單獨的SWA分支，而是強制將最近的標記滑動窗口納入稀疏選擇。這種兩級KV共享允許所有交叉解碼器的KV快取從自解碼器的隱藏狀態構建。因此，預填充可以在自解碼器之後退出，跳過所有交叉解碼器層。在80B-A3B MoE模型上，HySparse2在長上下文檢索和多回合代理任務中超越了HySparse和混合SWA，同時大幅減少了預填充計算和KV快取存儲。
